required_next_artifacts.pass_predicate: Open/free source snapshot exists locally, is hash-bound, and satisfies source separation policy.

required_source.requirement: Acquire and hash NIST Chemistry WebBook SRD 69 thermophysical fluid-property table for water from https://webbook.nist.gov/cgi/fluid.cgi?Action=Data&Wide=on&ID=C7732185&Type=IsoBar&Digits=5&P=101.325&THigh=373.15&TLow=273.15&TInc=5&RefState=DEF&TUnit=K&PUnit=kPa&DUnit=mol%2Fl&HUnit=kJ%2Fmol&WUnit=m%2Fs&VisUnit=uPa%2As&STUnit=N%2Fm.

required_next_artifacts.pass_predicate: Target table is locked before scoring and hidden fields do not leak into model selection.

required_target.unit: density mol/l, viscosity uPa*s, thermal conductivity W/m*K

required_next_artifacts.pass_predicate: OC prediction/scoring rule is preregistered before target unsealing.

required_model.requirement: Predict hidden transport property by log-linear interpolation in temperature using only visible neighboring grid rows within the same phase.

required_next_artifacts.pass_predicate: Incumbent comparator is scored on the same held-out targets.

required_comparator.requirement: Predict every hidden row using the visible row closest to 298.15 K for that property.

required_next_artifacts.pass_predicate: OC residual advantage exceeds preregistered materiality threshold under uncertainty.

required_uncertainty.metric: relative absolute residual per hidden property; aggregate mean relative absolute error
required_uncertainty.requirement: fixed table precision plus visible-row interpolation residual envelope

required_next_artifacts.pass_predicate: Negative controls and falsifiers are declared and replayed without post-hoc adjustment.

required_falsifier.requirement: hidden transport properties appear in visible rows before prediction materialization; NIST WebBook source snapshot hash is missing or changes; constant room-temperature comparator ties or beats the interpolation model; fewer than 20 hidden property targets are scored

required_next_artifacts.pass_predicate: Clean replay regenerates the evidence pack hash and result verdict.
